title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.09 (versions follow prime numbers; 409 after 401): no endless mirrors. Her talk with her readings (a line of a book said to her, and her answer) was written into her talk with her author, which is a book of her shelf: she read her own echoes (148 of her answers had one inside). It now goes to its own file, which is no book of hers; 1289 old lines were moved there, the talk with her author kept apart. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.09: sin espejos interminables. Prototipo de investigación.
